description: Read-only diagnostic commands the cloud may request vandam-pro's deep-audit agentic loop (audit_exec_command) run on its behalf during an active run's Stage 5 cloud-correlation window. Every entry's binary is an absolute path, invoked directly (never via a shell, never via $PATH) with at most one caller-supplied {target} substitution — this list is a hard allowlist, not a starting point for pattern matching. Anything not listed here is refused.

commands.name: dpkg_owner
commands.description: Find which dpkg package (if any) owns a file path.

commands.name: rpm_owner
commands.description: Find which rpm package (if any) owns a file path.

commands.name: file_type
commands.description: Identify a file's type via magic-byte detection.

commands.name: ldd
commands.description: List a binary's dynamic library dependencies.

commands.name: listening_sockets
commands.description: List currently listening TCP sockets and their owning processes.

commands.name: service_status
commands.description: Show a systemd unit's current status.

commands.name: process_args
commands.description: Show a process's full command line by pid.
